title: Module Review Quiz: Template Programming & Generics

slides.title: Template Programming Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers function templates, class templates, non-type template parameters, template specialization, variadic templates, and type deduction in C++ (CPP_217 to CPP_224).

slides.title: Template Keyword (CPP_217)
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to introduce a template definition in C++.

slides.title: Type Parameter Declaration (CPP_217)
slides.prompt: Which keyword can be used interchangeably with 'typename' inside template parameter lists?

slides.title: Function Template Syntax (CPP_218)
slides.prompt: Fill in the missing bracket type used for specifying template parameter types.

slides.title: Class Templates (CPP_219)
slides.prompt: How do you instantiate an object of a class template named 'Box' for storing integers?

slides.title: Class Template Declaration (CPP_219)
slides.prompt: Fill in the placeholder type name for storing data inside the generic Array class.

slides.title: Non-Type Template Parameters (CPP_220)
slides.prompt: What is a 'non-type template parameter' in C++?
options: A template parameter that represents a constant value rather than a data type (e.g., int N)
A template that does not take any arguments
A template used only with void return types
A template instantiated at runtime instead of compile-time
slides.correctAnswer: A template parameter that represents a constant value rather than a data type (e.g., int N)

slides.title: Non-Type Parameter Example (CPP_220)
slides.prompt: Fill in the data type for specifying an array capacity size 'N' as a non-type parameter.

slides.title: Full Template Specialization (CPP_221)
slides.prompt: What is the primary purpose of Template Specialization in C++?
options: To define a custom implementation for a specific data type that differs from the generic template
To prevent templates from compiling for floating-point numbers
To speed up execution by removing virtual tables
To allow templates to accept private variables
slides.correctAnswer: To define a custom implementation for a specific data type that differs from the generic template

slides.title: Full Specialization Syntax (CPP_221)
slides.prompt: Fill in the empty template brackets required when declaring a full template specialization.

slides.title: Template Parameter Deduction (CPP_222)
slides.prompt: What occurs during Template Argument Deduction when calling 'add(5, 10)' for 'template <typename T> T add(T a, T b)'?
options: The compiler automatically deduces 'T' as 'int' based on argument types
A runtime exception is thrown if type is not specified explicitly
The program prompts the user for type casting
slides.correctAnswer: The compiler automatically deduces 'T' as 'int' based on argument types

slides.title: Variadic Templates Parameter Pack (CPP_223)
slides.prompt: Fill in the ellipsis symbol used to define a template parameter pack in variadic templates.

slides.title: Variadic Templates (CPP_223)
slides.prompt: What allows a C++ variadic template to accept an arbitrary number of arguments?

slides.title: Default Template Arguments (CPP_224)
slides.prompt: Fill in the assignment operator to set 'int' as the default type for template parameter 'T'.

slides.title: Compile-time Nature of Templates (CPP_217)
slides.prompt: At what stage of program execution does C++ generate specific code for instantiated templates?
